answer: Precondition: the audit can rerun the work, otherwise none of this holds. Each epoch the network samples one attestation in 20 and releases the payout only after three unrelated agents confirm the same result, drawn from different regions so one beacon cannot light two of them. Reward reaches its summit only at epoch 30 clean, and any miss resets the fable of a fast exit. Cost: 20x redundant compute, plus three honest confirmers per identity held for 30 epochs.
